messages.content: Predict a participant choice in a group-account experiment. There are 12 independent periods with four-person groups randomly reshuffled each period; communication is prohibited. Your permanent type is HIGH or LOW, and each group has two HIGH and two LOW members. Period endowments may be [50,50,50,50],[67,67,33,33], or [75,75,25,25], ordered HIGH,HIGH,LOW,LOW, totaling 200 tokens. Current endowments are announced at each period start. Each person simultaneously contributes a token amount from 0 to their own endowment to the group account. Remaining endowment equals starting endowment minus own contribution. If group total C reaches 100, everyone keeps all remaining tokens; otherwise everyone keeps C percent of their remaining endowment. Contributions above 100 do not increase the retained percentage. At the end, software randomly selects the same one of 12 periods for everyone for payment; 1 US dollar = 1.25 tokens. History lists confirmed own experience and group totals: period; endowments; own_endowment; own_contribution; group_total; remaining_own; earnings (baseline period earnings). Output only your number of contributed tokens, without explanation.
